# TMaps API Examples

> Live, client-side JavaScript examples for the TMaps APIs (maps, geocoding and routing with worldwide coverage and extra detail for Tunisia). Each example is a single HTML page using Leaflet, OpenLayers or MapLibre GL, and shows the exact API request it sends.

Key facts:
- API base URL: https://api.tmaps.tn ; tiles: https://tiles.tmaps.tn
- Authentication: `api_key` query parameter on every request (GET and POST). No Authorization header.
- Browser keys are restricted by authorized domains (Origin/Referer). No wildcard: add each subdomain and localhost. HTTP (non-HTTPS) requests are rejected with 403.
- Coordinates are WGS84 decimal degrees, `lat` / `lng`. Distances in meters, durations in seconds.
- Geocoding results give the point in `geometry.location` (`lat`, `lng`), a `formatted` address, a `confidence` score and `components`: street, commune, delegation, governorate, country.
- Errors are JSON `{"error": "..."}` with standard HTTP codes (400, 401, 403, 404, 429, 5xx).

## Display a map

- [01 Map with Leaflet](https://examples.tmaps.tn/01-raster-leaflet/): raster XYZ tiles `https://tiles.tmaps.tn/r-tile/{z}/{x}/{y}?api_key=…`, zoom 0–18.
- [02 Map with OpenLayers](https://examples.tmaps.tn/02-raster-openlayers/): same tiles with `ol.source.XYZ` and a shareable view in the URL.
- [03 Vector map styles with MapLibre GL](https://examples.tmaps.tn/03-vector-maplibre-styles/): styles `streets`, `dark`, `terrain`, `sunny` at `https://tiles.tmaps.tn/v-tile/{style}.json?api_key=…`.

## Find addresses and places

- [04 Address search (forward geocoding)](https://examples.tmaps.tn/04-geocoding-search/): `GET /geocoding/forward?q=…&country=TN&limit=5&proximity=lat,lng`. Returns `confidence` (0–1); save coordinates when ≥ 0.85.
- [05 Address from a map click (reverse geocoding)](https://examples.tmaps.tn/05-reverse-geocoding/): `GET /geocoding/reverse?lat=…&lng=…`. Returns the nearest address and its `distance` in meters.
- [08 Nearby places](https://examples.tmaps.tn/08-nearby-search/): `GET /geocoding/nearby?lat=…&lng=…&radius=…&categories=restaurant`. Radius up to 10,000 m, results sorted by distance.

## Complete use cases

- [12 Checkout address form](https://examples.tmaps.tn/12-checkout-address-form/): delivery address autocomplete with forward geocoding, auto-filled commune/delegation/governorate, and a draggable pin refined with reverse geocoding.
